text:
rahul: Heads up 0min: NimbusHW reported billing spikes for several customers. Root appears to be duplicate minute-aggregates when devices drop/reconnect. Need quick mitigation + reconciliation plan.

megan: Repro: device sends pulse_stream; network blip causes device to reconnect and resend last 30s, partner aggregator currently appends duplicates into minute buckets instead of deduping by sequence id. We see ~6-12% overcount for some customers.

dena: Also saw a timezone mismatch: Nimbus reports minute buckets in local tz (Europe/Berlin) but our adapter assumed UTC hour boundaries; DST change last wk amplified deltas.

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-1492 duplicate-nimbus-agg

rahul: Minimal short-term controls:
- ingest service: reject minute-buckets without either sequence_id or a device-origin nonce. Return 400 + hint to partner.
- accept optional "orig_ts" in payload and canonicalize to UTC at ingestion so hour boundaries align.

megan: Proposed payload (partner):
```json
{"device_id":"nimbus-44","minute_start":"2026-03-12T08:15:00+01:00","seq_id":"00001234","count":60}
```
Adapter should normalize minute_start -> "2026-03-12T07:15:00Z" on ingest.

dena: Dedupe algorithm ideas: keep a rolling 48-hour usage_fingerprint index keyed by sha256(partner_id + device_id + seq_id + minute_start) with TTL 48h. Ingest upsert by fingerprint. If duplicate detected, emit a trace log and increment duplicate_metric.

rahul: Backfill options: Nimbus pushed daily minute-archives via SFTP for last 30d. We can run a deterministic transform to produce hour buckets and produce adjustment events (negative corrections for overcount). Must coordinate with finance for crediting.

megan: Reconciliation thresholds: if partner vs marketplace delta <= 1% auto-adjust; 1%-5% create billing review card; >5% pause auto-adjust, create customer outreach plan. Dena: legal might want different thresholds by ARR.

dena: Action items:
- megan: API validation + tz-normalization + rejection errors (ETA 36h)
- rahul: fingerprint TTL design + redis index + metrics + alert (ETA 48h)
- dena: backfill runner plan + SFTP ingestion schema + dry-run on test accounts (ETA 72h)
- finance: (actioned by rahul) loop legal & accounting re: credits and customer comms (ETA 48h)

partner-nimbus-bot: Uploaded sample archive: sftp://nimbus-archive/partnerships/minutes/2026-02-*.tgz

megan: Example adjustment event we will emit for overcount (schema):
```json
{"adjustment_id":"adj-20260312-0001","original_window":"2026-03-12T07:00:00Z","sku":"nimbus-pro-hour","qty_delta":"-0.15000000","reason":"duplicate-minute-agg-correction","ref_partner_batch":"sftp://.../2026-03-12.tgz"}
```
Qty expressed in hours with 8-decimal rounding.

rahul: Ops runbook notes:
- pre-ingest validation: reject missing seq_id or nonce, return structured error code PT-400-MISSSEQ
- daily reconcile job at 01:00 UTC comparing partner-hours -> invoice-hours, write top-50 deltas into Jira project PARTNER-METERING
- backfill dry-run first on 3 pilot customers, review diffs, then run wider.

megan: Tests: duplicate replay (conn flaps), tz offsets (UTC vs CET vs CEST), DST-forward/back, sequence gaps, partial-minute partial-hour prorate. Unit tests assert deterministic hour sums.

dena: Customer comms draft for legal/pm review: "We identified and corrected duplicate usage reporting from Nimbus hardware which impacted a small set of customers. Verified adjustments will appear on your next invoice; if you believe your bill is incorrect please contact billing@redwood.ai."

rahul: Quick Q: do we want to accept both seq_id and a content-hash for legacy devices?

megan: Yes, accept either seq_id OR content_hash computed over payload. Document both in partner contract.

ops-bot: Pager created for partner-ingest-ops when duplicate_metric > 1000/min for >10m

rahul: OK I'll host a partner sync tomorrow 9am PT to walk validation errors and backfill plan. Megan please bring API error examples; Dena bring finance/legal sync.

megan: :white_check_mark: 9am PT works, will prepare samples.

dena: I'll prep finance notes.

partner-nimbus-bot: Noted: Nimbus will push sequence_id for all devices by EOD.

rahul: Thanks team. I'll convert action items to Jira and post the runbook after the call.
